what_it_is: Preserved originals from a real cook or brew: photos, temperatures, weights, scores, receipts
guard: tools/intake.py preserves originals read-only with SHA-256; scoring rules in the readiness scoreboard

what_it_is: Behavior or responses from real guests under written rules
must_not_masquerade_as: intent or friends-only enthusiasm presented as demand
guard: research/customer-discovery templates stay header-only until real data; intent vs behavior kept separate in bm-inputs.csv

what_it_is: A raw written reply from a qualified professional, preserved unedited
must_not_masquerade_as: agent analysis, agent red-team or simulated readers presented as professional review
guard: docs/professional-reviews/ and intake.py professional_response kind; every agent file carries an AGENT ANALYSIS banner

what_it_is: A primary document opened and read (statute, registry record, official page)
counts_toward_evidence_score: YES (for the claim it verifies only)
must_not_masquerade_as: a search summary presented as verified
guard: tier T0/T2 rules in research/VERIFICATION-LEDGER.md; web-search summaries are T1 and never called verified

what_it_is: What a web search returned, pages not opened
guard: source and limit recorded per row; the site wording says reported, not confirmed

what_it_is: Text, models and tables produced by project agents
guard: AGENT ANALYSIS banners; decision register cannot promote an agent decision to founder-confirmed

what_it_is: An AI playing an investor, operator or guest
must_not_masquerade_as: investor interest, customer feedback or outside human review
guard: labelled AGENT INVESTOR RED-TEAM or SIMULATED READER REVIEW - NOT HUMAN EVIDENCE
status words; no PROVEN; site validator

must_not_masquerade_as: a photograph of a built place or a cooked dish
guard: media stage tag on every image; register-media refuses concept folders
provenance grades; UNKNOWN never enters; input_grade reported on every output
TEST_FIXTURE is excluded from every real run

what_it_is: A number or belief the founder states without a source
guard: provenance class FOUNDER_ASSUMPTION is grade C and never investor grade
